newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open down 0.60 to 0.80 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open down 0.60 to 0.80 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open 0.60 to 0.80 cent lower Monday, although LME three months continued slightly above $2,000 per tonne, absorbing overnight profit-taking and Far Eastern sales.
December COMEX last traded on ACCESS at 96.90 cents a lb, off 0.25 cent from Friday's close. The ACCESS trading range was 96.90 to 96.60 cents.
COMEX copper stocks rose sharply by 1,236 short tons Friday to 25,092 short tons.

Although LME stocks have been falling steeply, many traders expected COMEX stocks to rise because some of the metal from LME's Long Beach warehouse was making its way to COMEX depots following arbitrage deals.
